description: This file defines the class `Image_Graph_Plot_Area`, which is a subclass of `Image_Graph_Plot`. It implements an area chart plotting utility, including methods for rendering the plot and drawing legend samples. It relies on external classes such as `Image_Graph_Plot` and interacts with a canvas object to perform drawing operations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Area
classes.description: The `Image_Graph_Plot_Area` class provides functionality to create and render an area chart within the image graph framework. It extends the `Image_Graph_Plot` base class and overrides methods for drawing the area plot and its legend sample.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the area plot in the legend, illustrating the filled and bordered area shape.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the area plot, handling stacking, vertex calculations, and drawing the filled areas on the canvas.
